purpose: Source-grounded lab-memory evaluation for future local-worker harness integration.
novelty: New to this harness only. Authored from known lab evidence; not a held-out task set, contamination-free benchmark, or model-quality result.
isolation_requirement: Harness must expose only model_visible_files in a separate read-only input area. Do not give the worker this repository or directory containing the answer key. This packet does not implement that isolation.
validation_scope: Standard-library CPU checks of frozen Git provenance, hashes, question/key alignment and exact quoted line ranges. Response checks are structural only and never assign semantic points.
safe_run_contract: Read-only corpus/question access, no device/model/host actions from this packet; actual future inference ownership/resource admission remains the orchestrator responsibility.
limitations: Five curated documents are a bounded reading test, not arbitrary whole-lab retrieval.
Questions were authored using these documents; do not claim blind generalization.
Corpus relative links remain historical source text, not extra exposed files.
Semantic support, contradiction handling, factual scope and relevance require reviewer judgment.
No observed model answers, task success rates or speed results are recorded.
